cohort: A nationwide population-based cohort of all children born in Sweden between 1997 and 2016, specifically focusing on those identified with omphalocele.
finding: The national birth prevalence of omphalocele in Sweden was 1/10,000 live births, characterized by a high termination rate of 59% for prenatally diagnosed cases and a 1-year survival rate of 87% among those who continued the pregnancy.
